hypothesis: After an overnight gap accompanied by company news (<=3 tagged symbols, created in (prev 16:00 ET, D 09:25 ET]), fading the gap from 09:35/10:00 ET to 15:55 ET earns a positive SPY-adjusted return net of costs, more than fading a gap without such news.
hypothesis_source: Jev equity_priced shadow lane 2026-10-08..2026-10-16, 835 news calls, 211 names; an anecdote (7 sessions, one regime, mid prices, no costs).

excluded: PSKY (same security as SKYD; no bars)

statistic: equal-weight daily portfolio of side*(r_stock - r_spy), net of round-trip cost
discovery_gates: positive at base and every stress cost
positive after dropping the largest-|x| session and after dropping the best session
validation_gates: both chronological halves positive at every stress cost
